attempted_claim: Let Ta ⊂ CP^2, a in (0,1), be the Chekanov-type Lagrangian torus of Definition 3.2 of Tonkonog–Vianna (image under the 2:1 branched cover CP^1×CP^1 → CP^2 of \hat Ta; equivalently the presentation xy/z^2 in γ_a, |x/z|=|y/z|, with ω([line])=1). Prove that for every a in (0,1/3] the torus Ta is Hamiltonian non-displaceable from itself: φ(Ta) ∩ Ta ≠ ∅ for all φ in Ham(CP^2).
decisive_failure: The investigation established no positive rigidity: H^2-bulk Floer routes provably admit no critical point for a<1/3 by valuation, and all admissible low-area self-pairings vanish over Z/8, Z/4, Z/2 and C-local systems; the only positive low-area result covers Ta versus the Clifford torus for a<=1/9. Closing the (1/9,1/3) self-gap requires new higher-Maslov, odd-degree bulk, or non-Floer input beyond this session. Full route details are in output/WORKLOG.md and output/target_exit.json.
